core_obligations: Compute pi_{X*}F(U) = F(U \times_{varphi, X, pi_X} X) from the definition of pushforward on the etale site (proof lines 389-391). Since pi_X = F_X^f, the baffling-theorem construction gives the functorial isomorphism gamma_U = (varphi, F_U^f) : U -> U \times_{varphi, X, pi_X} X over X (proof lines 392-400). Define F(U) -> pi_{X*}F(U) as the restriction map of F along gamma_U^{-1}, which is a morphism of the etale site because gamma_U is an isomorphism (proof lines 401-407). The companion isomorphism pi_X^{-1}F \cong F is analogous (proof line 407).
proof_roadmap: Identify pi_{X*}F(U) with sections on the fiber product and transport the baffling functorial isomorphism to gamma_U = (varphi, F_U^f) (proof lines 389-400).
Define the descent isomorphism as restriction along gamma_U^{-1} and note the companion case is analogous (proof lines 401-408).
